title: Starter test and os verify print stack traces, a DATABASE_ERROR and secret-strength warnings on a passing run
body:
qa#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AecbS6JEeLdRWSW4AC

Filing gate: ③ a task on the maintainer's word. Asked in session on 2026-11-10, after the full-platform test run listed its improvement suggestions, verbatim: 「立卡处理」.

QA-source: #32135 · new-user flow (create-objectstack 18.3.0) · observed beside the clauses
Batch-of: objectstack-ai/objectstack#32135 follow-ups, 15 cards filed on the maintainer's 「立卡处理」

## What we saw

- The starter's `pnpm test` (one passing test that asserts a note without a title is refused) prints dozens of INFO lines and a WARN with a full stack trace for that expected refusal.
- `os verify` on the starter passes but prints hundreds of `[Registry] …` lines, `[sql-driver] DATABASE_ERROR … no such table: _objectstack_sequences`, and two better-auth warnings that the secret is short and low-entropy (verify's own in-process secret).

## Proposed change

Default these runs to warn-level output with the verdict at the end; an expected refusal inside a test is not logged with a stack; the sequences-table probe does not log DATABASE_ERROR when the table is simply not there yet; verify generates a full-strength ephemeral secret.

## Business reason

Who: every new user running the two commands the README tells them to run after each edit. Cost: a green run that looks red teaches people to ignore errors, which is the opposite of what verify is for.

## Reader

Triage first touch; lands in `packages/verify` (boot logging and secret) and the starter template's vitest config.

## Duplicate check

`is:issue repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack verify output noise Registry` (137, open and closed): no card for this.
